about: Record ids the head of evaluation excludes from the Bradley-Terry fit (protocol rule 6). Each entry: {"id": "<record id>", "reason": "<why, required>", "round": "<run whose record lists it>"}. The records stay in pairwise/*.jsonl; tools/eval/bt.mjs leaves them out of the fit and lists them in the generated JSON. An entry without a reason is rejected, not applied. Owner: head-of-evaluation. Round 1 excluded nothing (rounds/2026-10-14-round-1.md section 2).
